name: Guangdong Kitech New Material Holding Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Kitech New Material Holding Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of polymer modified plastics in the People’s Republic of China. The company offers nylon and polypropylene composites, as well as alloy, long glass fiber reinforced, and other products. It is also involved in the precision injection molding, precision mold design and development, plastic dye color matching, auto parts manufacturing, and children's car seat, and health protection products manufacturing businesses. The company’s special plastics products are used in manufacturing auto parts, baby carriages and child safety seats, sports equipment, home appliances, and other products. It exports its products. Guangdong Kitech New Material Holding Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Jiangmen, the People’s Republic of China.
